command: node src/cli/main.ts eval mask --slot <slot> --network --tool <codex-bin-dir> --tool <node-bin-dir> --credential <login>=/w/codex/auth.json --credential <slot>/codex/config.toml=/w/codex/config.toml -- /usr/bin/env CODEX_HOME=/w/codex <codex> exec --json --ephemeral --model <model> --sandbox workspace-write --cd /w/repo --color never -
setup: The argv krn eval session passes to the mask (src/evals/session.ts), run without the systemd scope. stdin is the prompt "Reply with OK.\n". <slot> holds repo/ (a git repository with one empty commit) and codex/config.toml (mode 0444); <codex> is the mise install of codex 0.167.0; <login> is ~/.codex/auth.json unless a capture says otherwise. Each capture records stdout and stderr byte for byte; nothing was redacted.
source: https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/rust-v0.167.0/codex-rs/exec/src/exec_events.rs: TurnFailedEvent has only error; TurnCompletedEvent has usage

https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/rust-v0.167.0/codex-rs/exec/src/event_processor_with_jsonl_output.rs: turn.completed usage is the thread total; a terminal turn shuts exec down; ConfigWarning, DeprecationNotice and Warning become item.completed error items
https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/rust-v0.167.0/codex-rs/exec/src/lib.rs: exec exits 1 only after an error without will_retry or a failed or interrupted turn

captures.name: turn-failed
captures.question: Does turn.failed carry usage?
captures.config: the session config for the model, byte for byte

captures.config: the session config for the model plus `skills = false` under [features]

captures.config: the session config for the model; the mask ran with PATH=/nonexistent, so spawning bwrap failed and Codex never started

captures.config: the session config for the model; <login> was a file holding {} so ChatGPT authentication failed on every retry
